description: Minimal tracker-neutral delivery posture. Review acquisition supports native subagents without Python helpers and exact content-based base-move reopening. Declared delivery-product gates, recovery and honest cost coverage remain host-native. Terminal handoffs retain the bound review release identity and any mid-review install. Shared v2 run observations retain selected structured output through compatible runtime capture. Coherent round briefs separate bounded delivery from unbounded planning; candidate checkouts and shared resources are isolated explicitly.
